description: This file defines the class FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration, which implements plugin and console configuration interfaces for the OrangeHRM application. It sets up autoloading for the package 'OrangeHRM\FunctionalTesting' and registers specific console commands related to database savepoints and resets, depending on the product mode. It also adds an event subscriber for the functional testing plugin.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configures the functional testing plugin for OrangeHRM by setting up autoloading and command registration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up class autoloading, and adds an event subscriber.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers functional testing related console commands if the product mode is not production.
